title: epoll is not provided by QNX 8.0
hint: Use poll()/select() for portable readiness; redesign edge-triggered dispatch or use ionotify() for native notifications.

title: Linux eventfd interface
hint: Use a pipe for a portable wake-up FD or QNX pulses/ionotify for a native event loop. Preserve counter behavior explicitly.

title: Linux signalfd interface
hint: Consider sigwaitinfo()/sigtimedwait() in a signal thread; explicitly bridge to the event loop if needed.

title: Linux timerfd interface
hint: Use POSIX timer_create() with signal delivery or a QNX pulse; it is not a file descriptor.

title: Review inotify semantics on QNX
hint: QNX 8.0 documents inotify in libfsnotify (-lfsnotify); verify supported events and filesystem behavior. ionotify covers device readiness, not filesystem event parity.

title: Linux process-control extension
hint: Map each prctl operation independently; ThreadCtl() covers selected thread controls, not process-control parity.

title: Linux system-information interface
hint: Query the needed fields with documented sysconf(), uname(), or target-specific QNX APIs rather than recreating struct sysinfo.

title: Linux-specific /proc/self path
hint: QNX procfs is not Linux procfs. Check the exact entry; inspect process state with QNX procfs/devctl where appropriate.

title: Linux UAPI header
hint: Use POSIX/QNX interfaces. Keep Linux kernel declarations in a Linux-only backend.

title: Linux-specific dynamic-loader link flag
hint: QNX provides dlopen() in libc; remove -ldl for QNX or let CMake select CMAKE_DL_LIBS.

title: Linux-specific realtime link flag
hint: QNX provides timer_create() in libc; remove -lrt for QNX if this is the only dependency.

title: Linux-specific pthread library link flag
hint: QNX provides pthread functions in libc. Prefer the build system's thread detection over hard-coding -lpthread.

title: Check QNX socket library linkage
hint: Link libsocket with -lsocket for networking calls on QNX; add it only to targets that need it.

title: Linux platform guard has no visible QNX branch
hint: Review the fallback for QNX. Where behavior needs a QNX backend, select it with the QNX compiler macro __QNXNTO__.

title: Linux affinity interface
hint: Set the QNX thread runmask with ThreadCtl() and _NTO_TCTL_RUNMASK; check mask width and inheritance before porting.

title: Review gettid assumptions on QNX
hint: QNX documents gettid(); do not treat its thread ID as a system-wide Linux TID. Use pthread_self() for portable thread identity.

title: Linux mmap population flag
hint: Do not rely on Linux prefault behavior on QNX. Review mmap() and residency requirements explicitly.

title: Review SO_REUSEPORT semantics on QNX
hint: Verify io-sock bind and distribution behavior; cross-user reuse can require the network/reuseport ability.

title: Review glibc backtrace interface
hint: Prefer debugger unwinding; QNX documents a best-effort, unsupported libbacktrace interface with different APIs.

title: Review allocator statistics on QNX
hint: QNX documents mallinfo() in libc. Do not rely on glibc-specific field interpretations or assume mallinfo2() is available.
